methodology.Rule: Editorial baseline is sourced manually; automated headline sampling is not editorial fact-checking
methodology.Reason: Prevent claim that headline tone means financial tailwind

methodology.Rule: Publisher/primary-institution RSS feeds; keyword-tagged titles, article URLs, original publication timestamps; editorial claims still require source validation
methodology.Reason: Publisher feeds have gaps, caps and potential access failures; headlines are not full-text evidence
methodology.Implementation Status: Automatic daily collection active; feed failures visibly recorded

methodology.Rule: Preserve each scanner run's UTC date, fixed lookback window, source diversity, event counts and coverage
methodology.Reason: Compare what was known then vs now

methodology.Rule: Compare fixed equal-size date windows; mark insufficient coverage until enough recorded dates
methodology.Reason: Avoid false regime flips from patchy history

methodology.Rule: Simple transparent positive/negative headline keywords; never equate to sector investment attractiveness
CDS named-company / sovereign events tracked as news; no live single-name CDS quotes on a free reliable public feed
HY OAS linked from FRED/ICE; cannot substitute for issuer CDS and should not be copied in bulk
Map source news → direct effect → second-order beneficiaries/vulnerable → critical invalidation
Monitor elections, war, sanctions, trade, rates, inflation, CDS, energy and large companies
Momentum in headline counts = attention change, not causal sector return forecast
Require source diversity, consistent date scopes and market/earnings confirmation before upgrade
Title/link sample; caps, rate limits and ambiguous article attribution; sources may be missing
methodology.Reason: Not comprehensive, cannot promise all news

coverage.news: Seven manually verified/publicly sourced research events plus a separately timestamped, sampled RSS article archive. It is not comprehensive.
coverage.CDS: No live entity or sovereign CDS quotes
coverage.comparison: Historical comparisons require actual overlapping source collection across both windows; a newly collected old RSS item is not evidence of complete older coverage.
coverage.sectorWatch: Seven dated hypotheses are analyst-editorial prioritization, not automated investable ranks; confirm using primary earnings and market prices.

watchCandidates.Investment Thesis To Watch: Foreign flows are returning and domestic financials/autos have led recent performance; verify earnings and inflow persistence.
watchCandidates.Confirmation Needed: Repeat FPI inflows plus earnings revisions and strong retail registrations
watchCandidates.Invalidate / Caution: Higher US yields reverse flows; stretched valuations

watchCandidates.Investment Thesis To Watch: Softer crude may improve input margins and inflation, but Hormuz insurance/shipping still volatile.
watchCandidates.Confirmation Needed: Sustained oil relief and falling freight costs show in profit spreads
watchCandidates.Invalidate / Caution: Fresh tanker attacks, higher oil or price competition takes savings

watchCandidates.Bucket: Structural watch; not fresh regime signal
